data.name: Sample - Zscaler - 2.2.0
data.description: Sample playbooks for "Zscaler" connector. If you are planning to use any of the sample playbooks in your environment, ensure that you clone those playbooks and move them to a different collection, since the sample playbook collection gets deleted during connector upgrade and delete.

workflows.name: Unblock URLs
workflows.description: Removes URLs from the "Blacklisted URL List" in Zscaler based on the URLs you have specified.

workflows.name: Get MD5 Cloud Sandbox Report
workflows.description: Retrieves a full or summary report of the file that was analyzed by Sandbox. The file is represented by the specified MD5 hash.

arguments.title: Zscaler: Get Cloud Sandbox Report MD5 Hash

arguments.name: Zscaler
arguments.operationTitle: Get Cloud Sandbox Report MD5 Hash

routes.name: Start-> Get Cloud Sandbox Report MD5 Hash

workflows.name: Get Whitelist URLs
workflows.description: Retrieves the list of all the whitelisted URLs from Zscaler.

workflows.name: Update exempted URLs
workflows.description: Adds a URL to or removes a URL from the cookie authentication exempt list. in Zscaler.

workflows.name: Get URL Categories Quota
workflows.description: Gets information on the number of unique URLs that are currently provisioned for your organization as well as how many URLs you can add before reaching that number from Zscaler.

workflows.name: Get Exempted URLs
workflows.description: Gets a list of URLs that were exempted from the cookie authentication in Zscaler.

workflows.name: Get Cloud Sandbox Report Quota
workflows.description: The resource access quota for retrieving Sandbox Detail Reports is restricted to 1000 requests per day, with a rate limit of 2/sec and 1000/hour from Zscaler.

arguments.title: Zscaler: Get Cloud Sandbox Report Quota

routes.name: Start-> Get Cloud Sandbox Report Quota

workflows.name: Get URL Category Details
workflows.description: Gets the URL category information for the specified category ID from Zscaler.

workflows.name: Get Blacklist URLs
workflows.description: Retrieves the list of all the blacklisted URLs from Zscaler.

workflows.name: Get Lightweight URL Categories
workflows.description: Retrieves a lightweight key-value list of all or custom URL categories from Zscaler.

workflows.name: Add URL Category
workflows.description: Adds a new custom URL category in Zscaler.

workflows.name: Update Whitelist URLs
workflows.description: Adds or removes URLs from the "Whitelisted URL List" in Zscaler based on the URL and action you have specified.

workflows.name: Block URLs
workflows.description: Adds URLs to the "Blacklisted URL List" in Zscaler based on the URLs you have specified.

workflows.name: Delete URL Category
workflows.description: Deletes the custom URL category for the specified ID from Zscaler.

workflows.name: Update URL Category
workflows.description: Adds or removes URLs from the category list for the specified URL category in Zscaler.

workflows.name: URL Lookup
workflows.description: Look up the categorization of the given set of URLs in Zscaler.

workflows.name: Get URL Categories
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of all categories from Zscaler.
